name: Umuahia
registryBasis: An Abia State Ministry process document locates a Zonal Land Office in Umuahia and states it processes Certificates of Occupancy, title confirmation through the Deeds Registry/ABIAGIS, survey charting and inspection. The state property portal documents land-title/registration workflows requiring applicant identity and supporting property documents. This confirms a local Umuahia office and record service, not open parcel geometry or citywide coverage.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The verified Umuahia land-office workflows are document/application based and require ownership or survey-plan materials. No anonymous full-polygon service/schema was verified; no application or property query was submitted.
scopeLimits: First-party source discovery only. No owner, address, tax, personal-identity, credential, account, or property-identifier lookup was submitted or retained. No full parcel geometry was retained. The supplied WUP point is not treated as a legal boundary.
remainingUncertainty: Whether an anonymous city-scoped full-polygon service exists and whether the WUP point corresponds to the named local record unit remain unverified.
